body: APOD Science APOD APOD: 2026 September 14 –… Today’s APOD Archive Submissions Index Search Calendar RSS Education About Discuss APOD Astronomy Picture of the Day Discover the cosmos! Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. Where Your Elements Came From Explanation: The hydrogen in your body and present in every molecule of water came from the Big Bang . There are no other appreciable sources of hydrogen in the universe. The carbon in your body was made by nuclear fusion in the interior of stars, as was the oxygen . Much of the iron in your body was made during supernova s of stars that occurred long ago and far away. body: TL;DR Android is making it easier and safer to move passwords and passkeys between supported password managers. The new system removes the need to export your password vault as a potentially unencrypted file and manually import it elsewhere. Password transfers currently work with Google Password Manager, 1Password, Bitwarden, and Dashlane, with more services coming later. Passwords are basically the keys to our digital lives. They protect everything from our emails and social media accounts to banking apps and personal photos, so the last thing you want is to accidentally leave them exposed. Unfortunately, that can become a concern when you decide to switch password managers. Right now, you may have to export your entire vault as a file, save it to your device, and then import it into your new password manager . Worse, that exported file can be unencrypted, which means all those usernames and passwords you’ve spent years protecting could temporarily sit together in a regular file on your phone. You also have to remember to delete it once you’re done.
